text:
maria: quick async check-in — pushed kernel prefetch change to canary at 09:10. initial perf looks good: ~5% lower P95 on short seqs, but I see a couple of 2s spikes on 8k+ sequences. rolling back is easy if noisy :eyes:

josh: nice. which canary pool? dedicated or shared?

maria: shared-gpu-canary-3. config: prefetch 3->5, microbatching still enabled. PR: #1423.

nina: saw the spikes too in the trace. looks correlated with KV eviction events. attaching quick diff of the evict window I used:
```
- kv.evict_threshold_ms = 120
+ kv.evict_threshold_ms = 240
```

liam: hmm, that change delays eviction which could keep cold entries around longer — might trade memory for latency. what are memory footprints on canary?

maria: up ~8% transient. not hitting OOM.

josh: can you paste the minimal repro command? I'll run locally on prod-ish dataset.

maria: run this locally: `./perf/run --model redwood-small --seq 8192 --batch 4 --kv-warmup 200` — use the canary build tag `canary-prefetch-1423`.

liam: running now. will post results in ~15m.

nina: also note microbatch has a fallback threshold: if queue latency > 80ms we flush immediate. that might interact with prefetch window.

maria: good catch. I bumped microbatch default from 12->16 ops, maybe too aggressive.

josh: if microbatch grows, cold requests wait longer for batch fill -> larger end-to-end latency for 1-offs. maybe tune to 10 for canary.

liam: local run: P95 short seq improved 4.7%, but long seq P99 had 1.9s outliers when eviction and batch fill overlap. I captured logs, uploading to the canary trace link: https://redwood/traces/1983007890/canary.

maria: thanks. i'll try lowering microbatch to 10 and increase eviction threshold to 300ms on canary and re-run.

josh: +1. if stable for an hour we can promote. also add a short perf test to the CI matrix: `ci/perf/canary-smoke.sh --seq 8192` so we get automated guardrails.

maria: will open follow-up PR with both config tweaks and a CI smoke. assigning to @josh for quick review.

deploy-bot: canary deployment 1983007890 -> shared-gpu-canary-3 succeeded at 09:12 (tag: canary-prefetch-1423). :rocket:

nina: small ops note — I'll add a dashboard panel for 'batch fill time vs eviction events' so we can correlate without digging traces.

liam: thanks. no blockers from my side after the run.

josh: I'll review PR in a bit. if all good we push the microbatch tweak then monitor for 2h, else rollback.

maria: plan sounds good. ping me if you see regression. :thumbsup:

josh: one more ask — add a one-liner in PR description about fallback behavior when queue latency spikes so on-call knows when it's intended.

maria: done.
